Title: Tournament report Path of Death and Soul Utrecht [short]

Messages.Author: Emile Bosman
Messages.Body:
It was another crowded tournament in the Jaarbeurs hallen in Utrecht
last saturday 02-07-2004 even though it wasn't a sanctioned
tournament.
20 players showed up.
As usual I will only report on the finals.
The following players went into the finals

1 Tobias :Samedi Shamblings.
2 Dietmar :Nosferatu Princes with rush.
3 Paul :Nosferatu princes with third traditions.
4 Emiliano :Gangrel combat with ravenspy intercept.
5 Jeroen :Tzimisce big cap pre vote.

The finals didn't really have any fast agressive deck so it started of
pretty slow also being hindered by three vote decks.
Paul and his Nosferatu third tradition deck managed to keep pressure
on Emiliano's Gangrel deck for almost the entire game bringing him
down to four pool several times.
But since he didn't have a good vote lock he had to get the help of
Dietmar and his Nosferatu princes.
Tobias and his Shambling hordes also kept the presure on Paul with
bleeds for 5 or 6 and rushing him with his Hordes.
Paul eventually got stopped by Dietmar who played an Anathema on one
of his princes before rushing him and collecting the pool.
This gave Tobias an oppertunity to oust Paul and walk away with the
only victory point gained in the entire finals.
And here is Tobias his deck list.
